en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5468 - As for the narration of Ali ibn Asbaṭ from Thaʿlabah from Abu Al-Hasan Amr ibn Shaddad Al-Azdi from Ammar ibn Musa from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"A man has the most right over his wealth as long as his soul remains in him. If he bequeaths all of it, it is permissible for him."
